seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: born x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Mechanics: 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours (axis 10, target 11, reflection 4, piece 5, bg 9).
A1-A4 move the selection by one block (axis ignores A3/A4; pieces blocked by board edge and other pieces); A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Piece blocks off the axis row reflect to 2a-b unless off-board or under a piece; layers wall<target<reflection<piece.
Holes are transparent: target shows through, else fill 0 (selected piece), 4 (reflection), 9; selected axis dot = 0. HUD col 63 +1 colour-12 cell per effective action.
Unconfirmed: budget overflow past 63, piece entering axis row, A5 order with equal-size pieces. Passes 29/29 stateless too.
